//: Production overlay for `tauri build`, applied via `--config src-tauri/tauri.prod.json`. Deep-merged over tauri.conf.json, which stays dev-branded on purpose so a developer's window title / app-data dir are visibly distinct from a real install. Previously the production identity was never overridden anywhere, so a release bundle shipped as 'ZCode (Tauri dev)_0.0.0_amd64.AppImage' with a .dev bundle identifier.
